notes.note: Speakers verified in event 0711.bla. Blocks 0.73-0.87, 0.89-0.103 and 0.108-0.122 are leader variants indexed by the second Pt_Chara_Check sequence: God Gundam, OOO, Nu Gundam, W, Zeta, Black RX, Wing Zero, Rider 1, 00, Den-O Sword Form, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero. So 0.82 = Momotaros (his 'Here I go' catchphrase), 0.83-0.85 Taro/Ultraman/Seven, 0.86 Mebius, 0.87 Zero.
'them' = the multiplied Gundam Heads (end of slice 149: they have multiplied; after the battle the leaders complain about the numbers).

0.89-0.103 leader variants (same order): 0.89 God Gundam, 0.90 OOO, 0.91 Nu, 0.92 W, 0.93 Zeta, 0.94 Black RX, 0.95 Wing Zero, 0.96 Rider 1, 0.97 00, 0.98 Momotaros, 0.99-0.101 Taro/Ultraman/Seven, 0.102 Mebius, 0.103 Zero. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Name label is ??? (CHARA_NAME 30); it is the Dinosaur Greeed laughing before he appears (Ankh names him next row).
One sentence cut across 0.106/0.107 (worn down... by the Gundam Heads); English cut at the same point.

0.108-0.122 leader variants (same order). 0.111 is the W variant and the script labels it W (Philip) instead of the leader (CharaNameIn 198), matching his voice; translated as Philip. 0.112 (Zeta) says 'parent' rather than 'boss'. 'We'll' chosen so identical Japanese across God/RX/Rider 1/Mebius/Zero stays identical.
Dinosaur Greeed (Dr. Maki) polite register kept; 'it' = Devil Gundam.
This laugh (TextIdOffset+124) is never called by 0711.bla, so it is likely unused. Unlabelled; treated as the Dinosaur Greeed by context (same text as 0.150).

Glossary term (Self-Regeneration/Self-Multiplication/Self-Evolution) kept in the source's order: evolution, regeneration, multiplication. Japanese brackets dropped for length. The subject 'Gundam Heads' moved from the start of 0.127 into 0.128: with it, 0.127 wraps to 3 lines (the three terms are long). Same sentence, same content split otherwise.
Memory Memory: the Gaia Memory the party was searching for (slice 149); quotes kept as in the source.

Slice label 'Zero' is wrong. The script shows only TextIdOffset+133 (entry 0.134) under the current leader's name, with no leader offset, so 0.134 plays for every leader and 0.135-0.148 look unused. Variant order (from the 0.152 block's EQ checks): OOO, W, Black RX, Rider 1, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, Taro, 00, Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu, God Gundam. The 'we' (ware-ware) rows 0.141-0.143 = Seven/Ultraman/Taro get a more formal wording.
Causative ('had them collected'): the agent isn't named, so the passive keeps it open (the Gundam Heads fighting the heroes, or the Memory Memory). 'negative memories' kept literal.

Slice labels 'Zero' are wrong for 0.152-0.162. Script EQ checks give the leader per entry: 0.152 OOO, 0.153 W (Shotaro), 0.154 Black RX, 0.155 Rider 1, 0.156 Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros), 0.157 Zero, 0.158 Mebius, 0.159 Seven, 0.160 Ultraman, 0.161 Taro, 0.162 00 (0.163-0.166 = Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu, God Gundam in story_151).
00 (Setsuna) trails off; it continues into Dinosaur Greeed's 'They do exist!!' in story_151, so the line stays unfinished.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified in 0711.bla: slice labels 'Zero' on 0.134 and 0.152-0.162 are wrong (leader variants; per-entry leaders in notes). 0.111 is W (Philip). 0.125 is likely unused. 0.134 plays for every leader. No new names.
